rotation_policy: Reconcile every candidate against live WordPress and all three archives. Preserve every active subject, including newly created specialty tracks. Never renumber or duplicate. Require 2–10 relevant in-story media and unique 1200×630 current-cover-rotation image, correct links and footer. Archive identical final Gutenberg source to three repositories. Mark live visual or playback limitations explicitly and advance the subject pointer only as publication-state evidence warrants. Do not create or embed custom conceptual schematics or diagrams in lessons; source-grounded charts are allowed. Prefer open educational universities, official training institutions, open-source education providers and credited genuine equipment photographs and videos; distinguish educational source data from measured production results. Rotate visual age presentation, gender presentation, and person/equipment cover subjects across successive lessons instead of repeating the same profile; source authentic media for in-body photographs and label fictional or AI-made covers as illustrations. Choose lesson-cover subject from the lesson's real technology, artifact, code, equipment, or software first; include a rotating person only if relevant to the teaching subject. Never insert a person solely to satisfy demographic rotation; maintain demographic diversity among covers that genuinely benefit from people.
